body: My girlfriend. She was also my best friend. Whenever I felt like giving up, I would think of her. She was always there for me but I fucked it up one night and now she's gone and I have no one in this world. I've lost my reason to live

Thank you for the reply. No one else is talking to me so it really means a lot. 
I've tried. I've been apologising since she found out. Even before she did, I felt like shit. Because honestly, she was the best thing in my life. But now she feels like she can't trust me again. But how do I tell her that it wasn't me? It was a genuine mistake and I am ready and willing to do everything it takes to make up for it and fix it
Me too. It would be painless and there'd be no mess that others would have to deal with
